# Pocket benchmark structures

Downloaded on 2026-10-13 from `https://files.rcsb.org/download/{ID}.pdb`.
RCSB PDB data are CC0. These ten entries are the pre-registered pocket benchmark.

Tuning, used to change the grid after the first core-filling failure: 3PTB, 1STP, 1HSG, 1FKF, 2PK4.

Held-out, not used to choose parameters: 1AQ1, 1TLP, 2GBP, 4DFR, 1DWD.

The ligand is the largest non-buffer HET residue. SHA-256 values are in `backend/tests/test_pockets.py`.
